name: Mitten Extracts Max Pro Disposable | Watermelon Jolli Popz
description:
Juicy and refreshingly sweet, Watermelon Jollipopz captures the classic taste of watermelon candy in every pull. The Max Pro device enhances the experience with smooth hits and consistent flavor from start to finish.

Packed with 3G of Liquid Diamonds + Live Resin terpenes for a smooth, powerful experience that lasts. Fine-tune every hit with Flavor, Balance, or Clouds mode.
